name: Mexican Meat
time: ~10 hr 15 min, ~20 min hands-on (mostly slow cooker; estimated)

steps.title: Slow cook
steps.body: Place in crock pot with beef roast, pork roast, large chopped onion, **1 can green salsa** and **2 sticks cinnamon**. Cook on high about 10+ hours, until meat shreds easily.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve over rice with salsa and sour cream, or put in a burrito or your favorite Mexican casserole.

yields: Depends on the size of the roasts (not given) (estimated)
